features.name: Turn left
features.note: Route intent. eta^2 = 0.83 against the dataset’s recorded intent labels; active on 95.4% of GO_LEFT frames vs 4.6% of GO_STRAIGHT.

features.name: Turn right
features.note: Route intent. eta^2 = 0.70; the GO_RIGHT counterpart of latent 19.

features.name: Brake
features.note: Longitudinal. Slows the plan monotonically on 100% of sampled frames; past alpha ≈ 1.1 the planner switches to a stopping plan outright.

features.name: Accelerate
features.note: Longitudinal. Speeds the plan up monotonically on 100% of sampled frames (mean +1.80 m/s at alpha = 2).
